thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert detected: rapid GPU queue growth in us-west1-primary pool. Queue length exceeded routing threshold (Q>1200) and autoscaler attempted scale but hit soft-cap. Autoscale error: "scale failure: reached pool max_instances". Starting incident thread at 2298765432

sara (oncall): paging oncall now. I’m looking. Any customer-facing impact yet?

ops-bot: Paging: sara (oncall) via PagerDuty (PD#2345). Escalation to SRE after 5m.

raj (runtime): digging in. Early signs: a new model variant (v3b) started getting routed heavy prefix requests from a high-throughput tenant; memory per replica increased ~18%. This pushed active instances to soft cap and queue backlog grew. Metric snippets: 
```
pool: us-west1-primary
active_replicas: 48 / 48 (soft-cap)
queue_length: 1278
avg_token_latency: 340ms
throttled_requests: 432
```

mike (sre): oncall, are we seeing cross-region spillover kicking in? If not, maybe sticky session routing prevented remote failover.

raj (runtime): spike started at +00:03. Cross-region routing attempted but sticky session affinity on some clients prevented move. A subset of requests still routed to us-west1 due to client pinning. Router logs show 
```
ERROR: route-eval: preferred=us-west1, fallback=eu-west1, routed=us-west1 (affinity)
```

lia (infra): can do a quick manual route override for low-priority tenants and warm a helper pool in eu-west1. Suggest throttling low-priority classes first.

emma (support): we have 3 customers in PLG tier reporting increased 5xx and timeouts (support#2457). They show 500s (model OOM) and timeouts around 20s. Flagging for comms.

sara (oncall): plan: 1) throttle low-priority tenants (10%) 2) manual route-override to eu-west1 helper pool for eligible routes 3) spin up temporary warm pool in eu-west1 (increase capacity) 4) evict long-running low-priority jobs. Proceed?

mike (sre): +1. Also enable emergency circuit-breaker to drop new large-context requests to v3b for 10m.

lia (infra): running commands now.
```
# throttle low-priority routes
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/routing/throttle \
  -d '{"scope":"plg","pct":10}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx'

# manual route override for helper pool
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/routing/override \
  -d '{"from":"us-west1-primary","to":"eu-west1-helper","selector":"tenant_class:plg"}'

# warm helper pool
kubectl scale deployment eu-west1-helper-replica --replicas=16 -n inference
```

lia (infra): helper pool warm initiated, logs show warm replicas healthy after ~90s.

ops-bot: Route override applied to 12% of PLG routes. Throttle applied.

raj (runtime): router metrics show drop in queue growth after override. New snapshot: 
```
queue_length (us-west1): 420 -> trending down
queue_length (eu-west1-helper): 110 -> stable
active_replicas (us-west1): 48 -> 44
throttled_requests: 432 -> 180
```

emma (support): customers reporting improvement. One enterprise customer still seeing degraded tail latency (they're pinned to us-west1). Recommending targeted comms and manual session migration.

sara (oncall): calling PD escalation: can SRE reach out to the customer engineering contact to explain manual migration? @mike can you take that?

mike (sre): on it. Messaging drafted and sending to CSE channel. :thumbsup:

raj (runtime): note: autoscaler logs show the max_instances cap was hit because the pool config has a hard cap due to binpacking constraints (gpu-type mismatch between some reserved pools). We should consider temporary softening of binpack constraints or borrowing spare capacity from dedicated pools in emergencies.

lia (infra): I just temporarily set binpack.strict=false on us-west1-swarm for emergency fallback; that allowed 4 more instances to join. Command: 
```
infractl pools update us-west1-swarm --binpack-strict=false --dry-run=false
```

ops-bot: infra change recorded in audit (change#A-9087).

raj (runtime): after binpack change + route override + throttles, queue stabilized and errors dropped. Stats 12m post-mitigation: 
```
queue_length (us-west1): 420 -> 190
5xx_rate: 2.7% -> 0.6%
p95_latency: 2.1s -> 1.1s
```

sara (oncall): declaring incident mitigated at 2298766212. Keeping thread open for a short postmortem and follow-ups.

emma (support): opening customer incident notes and comms drafts. Will notify customers flagged earlier that we routed their traffic to eu-west1-helper for load relief.

mike (sre): follow-ups: 1) increase emergency borrowing quota between pools, 2) revisit autoscaler soft-cap behavior + alert thresholds, 3) add sticky-session detection in router to auto-break affinity when target pool overloaded, 4) create a runbook item for manual route override. I'll create JIRA tickets.

raj (runtime): also adding an eval to test v3b mem profile under high concurrency; need to update model onboarding checklist.

lia (infra): will roll back binpack.strict change after traffic normalizes and we confirm no long-term fragmentation issues.

sara (oncall): thanks team. Incident mitigated, will follow up with RCA and impact summary. :white_check_mark:
